caption: The drawing depicts a metallic lantern with a square base and a pointed, four-sided roof. The lantern is rendered in shades of gray and black, giving it a monochromatic look. It features arched openings on all visible sides with transparent panels, and there is a visible door with a latch on the left side of the front face. Inside the lantern, there is a single candle standing upright near the center. The roof has a circular loop attached at the top, suggesting a handle or a point for hanging. The surface of the drawing background is a plain, light-beige color, and there is a signature “SCHMIDT” in the bottom right corner.
title: Lantern
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
